name: gear-worklists-single-seam-archive-exclusion
description: The gear worklists (fabro run queue CLI, the fabro_client tool twin, the merger/adjudicator field queries) all funnel through exactly two store queries in lib/components/fabro-store/src/run_summary_store.rs: adjudication_queue (the pending/parked anti-join) and verdict_queue (the settled filter). A lifecycle policy like 'archived runs never queue' (denkhaus/work#1321) needs only the one AND archived_at_ms IS NULL clause in each query plus a flipped pin in the same file's tests -- no consumer-side changes anywhere. When adding a worklist-wide policy, patch the store seam, not the consumers.
